operator: PUB (Public Utilities Board), Singapore's National Water Agency
population_served_note: Total population end-June 2025 = 6,111,200 (SingStat / Population in Brief). PUB reports 100% population served by tapped water and modern sanitation (ASR 2024/25, CY). Connections/accounts ≈ 1.7 million households and businesses (PUB press release 5 Feb 2025); ASR FY customers ~1.756 million accounts.
water_loss_method: Distribution Losses % of potable water network (PUB indicator since 2019; replaced Unaccounted for Water). Described as accounting for all possible leaks. CY2025 = 7.2% (MSE parliamentary reply 8 Apr 2026). ASR 2024/25 GRI also lists CY2022=7.5, CY2023=7.2, CY2024=7.1. Not reported as L/conn·day in public sources found.
sewage_treatment_note: 100% population with modern sanitation (PUB ASR); 100% domestic wastewater safely treated (SDG 6.3.1, 2024). Island-wide sewerage + Deep Tunnel Sewerage System (DTSS) to Water Reclamation Plants; used water recycled to NEWater.

production_l_s_or_m3d.demand_approx_note: PUB states water demand currently about 440 million gallons a day (Water Loop page). Singapore historically quotes imperial gallons; 440 imp.mgd ≈ 2.00 million m3/d. Figure is approximate ('about').
production_l_s_or_m3d.sales_unit: SingStat Water Sales Annual — Million Cubic Metres Per Year; daily values = annual / 365.25. Sales ≠ production (excludes distribution losses).

digital_assets: Smart Water Grid (SWG) — island-wide monitoring of ~6,000 km potable network
Anomaly Leak Finder (ALF) — high-fidelity digital twin + AI/ML leak detection/localization (Bentley iTwin/OpenFlows; deployed on Government Commercial Cloud)
Permanent leak detection sensors — 1,500 units; acoustic data loggers and smartphone acoustic devices
Smart Water Meter Programme (AMI) — Phase 1 ~300,000 smart meters; MySmartWaterMeter portal (hourly/daily data, leak alerts)
SCADA — existing operational SCADA environment referenced in vendor digital-twin materials (official PUB public detail limited)
GPS tagging / geofencing of construction machinery near critical pipelines and sewers (since 2023)
Sewer Analytics and Management System; VOC and microbial electrochemical sensors on used-water network (Sustainability Report 2023)
Flood monitoring — water-level sensors, CCTVs, myENV / Telegram flood alerts, Quick Response Teams

quality_and_incidents.who_years: CY2022–CY2024 (PUB ASR); drinking-water quality open data 2023–2025 on data.gov.sg
quality_and_incidents.supply_restoration_avg: within four hours once leak isolated (PUB press release)

climate_resilience: Four National Taps (local catchment, imported Johor water to 2061, NEWater, desalination) — weather-resilient NEWater + desalination prioritized
Source-Pathway-Receptor stormwater approach; ~8,000 km drains; 17 reservoirs; 2/3 land as water catchment
Flood Resilience Cluster created 1 Aug 2025; flooding hotspots CY2022–24: 26 → 23 → 22
Year of Climate Adaptation 2026 (MSE); National Adaptation Plan targeted 2027
Coastal protection Site-Specific Studies; ABC Waters programme
cco_note: Term 'CCO' (Centro de Controle Operacional) not found in PUB public materials; operational control described via SCADA / Smart Water Grid / ALF / flood monitoring centres.
